scope: Frozen cursor source/binaries before restoration; static evidence only
loop_lowering: source pointer/full_end was optimized to a single remaining-full-bytes counter; add cursor64/add counter-64/jne, not literal pointer compare
partial_bounds: rax is full_end; r8 is full_end-64 on exit; rax/r8+0x50/r8+0x60 match p/p+16/p+32
r0_dispatch: mov original length/shr4/and3/indirect jump; two vmovdqa+directjmp
byte_tail_setup_extra: mov+and recompute bulk16 when <16B tail exists; applies to169/241
limitations: Lower loop bookkeeping did not imply lower complete CRC time; cursor lost guarded r0 bypass and added tail setup.
